cursor_select.title: Cursor / Select
cursor_select.description: Default safe mode. Lets the user click/select map items and edit existing shapes.
cursor_select.usage: Use this tool to select and edit shapes on the map. Click a shape to select it. Drag points to adjust.
rules: This is the default tool when the map loads.
Clicking a polygon selects it and shows edit points (vertices).
Dragging a vertex reshapes the polygon.
Clicking empty map clears selection (optional).
After finishing any drawing (polygon), the app auto-switches back to Cursor and selects the new shape.
quality_of_life: Show a small helper tip: 'Click a shape to edit. Drag points to adjust.'
Highlight the selected shape so users know what is active.

draw_polygon.title: Draw Area (Polygon)
draw_polygon.description: Draw an area by clicking points on the map. Best for selecting/excluding streets inside an area.
draw_polygon.usage: Select this tool, then click on the map to add corners. Double-click (or click the first point) to finish the shape. Afterwards, drag points to adjust.
rules: Click to add points (vertices).
A preview line should appear while drawing to show the next segment.
Finish drawing by double-clicking OR clicking the first point (choose one main behavior and keep it consistent).
Polygon must have at least 3 points to be valid.
Press ESC to cancel the drawing (removes the in-progress polygon).
After finishing, auto-switch back to Cursor and select the polygon so the user can edit it.
V1 recommendation: only allow one polygon at a time.
if_polygon_already_exists: Option A (simple): block new drawing and show message: 'Delete current area to draw a new one.'
Option B (slightly nicer): ask confirm: 'Replace existing area?' then replace if confirmed.
quality_of_life: Show helper tip while active: 'Click to add points. Double-click to finish. ESC to cancel.'
Show an 'Area selected' small panel after finish with quick actions (Edit / Delete).

circle_select.title: Circle Select (Radius)
circle_select.description: Fast selection tool. Click to place a circle and use a slider to change radius.
circle_select.usage: Select this tool, click on the map to place the circle center, then adjust radius using the slider.
rules: Click on the map places the circle center.
Circle appears with default radius (e.g., 200m).
Slider changes radius live (meters).
Clicking a new location moves the circle center (simple behavior).
Optional: allow dragging the center handle to move the circle.
V1 recommendation: only allow one circle at a time.
quality_of_life: Show the radius value next to the slider.

delete_selected.title: Delete Selected
delete_selected.description: Deletes only the currently selected shape (safe delete).
delete_selected.usage: Select a polygon (or other shape), then click Delete to remove it.
rules: Delete is disabled if nothing is selected.
Deletes only what is selected (never clears everything by default).
Optional: keyboard shortcut Delete/Backspace deletes selected shape.
quality_of_life: If the shape is being used in a workflow (e.g., 'exclude area'), show confirmation: 'Delete this area?'

marker_optional.title: Marker (Single Pin) — Optional
marker_optional.description: Place a single pin on the map for point-based actions (only add if you truly need it).
marker_optional.usage: Select this tool, click on the map to place a pin. Click elsewhere to move it. Click the pin to remove it.
rules: Only one marker at a time (v1).
Click on map places marker if none exists.
If marker exists, clicking elsewhere moves marker there.
Click marker removes it (or opens a small popup with Remove).
Marker is optional because your main use case is area selection (polygon/circle).
when_to_add: If you need actions like 'inspect near this point', 'set meeting point', 'set start location'.
If you have no clear point-based feature, skip this tool.

clear_all_optional.title: Clear All — Optional (Dangerous)
clear_all_optional.description: Removes all shapes and markers. Should be hidden in a menu and always confirmed.
clear_all_optional.usage: Open the More (•••) menu and choose Clear All. Confirm to remove everything.
rules: Do NOT place this as a main toolbar button (too easy to misclick).
Always show a confirmation modal: 'Clear all selections and drawings?'
After clearing, return to Cursor tool.
